Lubar & Company increased its stake in Star Group L.P. (SGU) by 527.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lubar & Company bought 1.05 million shares as the company’s stock declined 11.39% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.25 million shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $13.49 million, up from 200,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lubar & Company who had been investing in Star Group L.P. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $549.77M market cap company. The stock decreased 1.21% or $0.12 during the last trading session, reaching $9.78. About 24,492 shares traded. Star Group, L.P. (NYSE:SGU) has risen 2.84% since May 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.71% the S&P500.
